Sigma-Aldrich was the source of anti-HLTF (HPA 015284 to human HLTF aa 164-300). Abcam was the source of anti-HLTF (ab183042 to human HLTF aa 950-C-terminus), anti-protocadherin gamma (pan) - C-terminal (ab187186) and anti-perforin (ab180773) antibodies. Novus Biologicals was the source of anti-Cxcr7 (MAB42273). DBA lectin (L6533), diaminobenzidine (D12384), and Harris Modified Hematoxylin (HHS16) were purchased from Sigma-Aldrich for use with Streptavidin, peroxidase conjugate (189733) from MilliporeSigma. Biotinylated goat-anti-mouse (BA-9200) and goat anti-rabbit (BA-1000) IgG antibodies and the ABC-enzyme complex were purchased from Vector Laboratories, Inc. DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (69506) was purchased from Qiagen for isolation of genomic DNA from tail biopsies. SequalPrep™ Long PCR Kit with dNTPs (A10498) was purchased from ThermoFisher Scientific. PCR primers were synthesized by Midland Certified Reagent Company. OmniPur agarose (2120) was purchased from Calbiochem division of EMD4Biosciences, and MetaPhor® agarose (50181) was purchased from Lonza Rockland, Inc. Promega was the source of agarose gel markers (G171A, G173A, and G176A). ZR Genomic DNA-Tissue MidiPreps (D3110) were purchased from Zmyo Research for use in conjunction with Agilent DNA Chips (5067-1522) and DNA 12000 reagents on the Agilent 2100 bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Genotype and Sex Authentication
steps.instruction: Authenticate the Hltf genotype and fetal sex of the mice.

substeps.instruction: Perform PCR screening at weaning to distinguish Hltf null vs wild type genotypes.
Perform Rag2 genotyping using the protocol from bkeelab.bsd.uchicago.edu/Rag2.pdf.
Determine fetal sex by inspecting genital tubercles for a pigmented spot over the scrotum in males.
Validate sex via PCR analysis of the Sry sex-determining region of the Y chromosome and myogenin (Myog) of the X chromosome using DNA from fetal tail biopsies.

steps.title: Placental Tissue Processing
steps.instruction: Prepare placental tissues for histological evaluation.

substeps.instruction: Cut each uterine horn between implantation sites.
Peel placentae away from the decidua, maintaining the residual mesometrial myometrium landmark.
Immersion-fix tissues in formalin-based fixatives.
Cut tissues mid-sagittally and embed in paraffin face-down.
Serially section tissue blocks at 4 µm.
Place two sections on each slide and deparaffinize.

steps.title: Histological Staining and Imaging
steps.instruction: Perform staining and microscopy on the prepared sections.

substeps.instruction: Stain sections on every fifth slide with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) and evaluate by light microscopy.

Stain alternate slides for amylase-resistant periodic acid Schiff (PAS) positive granules, Dolichos biflorus (DBA) lectin reaction, or perform immunostaining for Hltf, protocadherin gamma, Cxcr7, and perforin1.
Use one section per slide for positive staining and the companion section for negative (minus primary antibody) control.

steps.title: Immunostaining Antibody Application
steps.instruction: Apply primary and secondary antibodies at specified concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Apply primary antibodies: Hltf (1:100 for HPA015284; 1:50 for ab183042), protocadherin gamma (1:5), Cxcr7 (1:10), and perforin1 (1:25).
Apply secondary antibody (biotinylated goat anti-mouse or goat anti-rabbit at 1:200) based on the primary antibody species.

steps.title: RNA-seq Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform gene expression and alternative splicing analysis using placental samples.

substeps.instruction: Flash freeze individual samples (1 placenta/sample x 5 biological replicates for test and control littermate female mice; 10 total).
Perform paired-end 100 nucleotide reads sequencing.
Align reads to genomic assembly mm10 using Tophat (V1.3.3) to generate .bam mapping files.
Use Cufflinks for transcript assembly and Cuffdiff (V 1.3.0) for statistical comparison between null and control conditions.
Import data into iPathwayGuide using standard enrichment parameters (0.6, p<0.05) and a minimum threshold log fold change (logFC) of 0.6.

steps.title: DNA Methylation Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze genomic DNA methylation using Methyl-MiniSeq Epiquest.

substeps.instruction: Flash freeze individual samples (1 placenta/sample x 3 biological replicates for null and control mice; 6 total).
Isolate genomic DNA and assess purity using the Agilent Bioanalyzer.
Subject DNA to fragmentation, endo modification, adaptor addition, bisulfite conversion, and limited amplification.
Generate nine data sets per sample (CpG islands, gene promoters, and gene bodies in CpG, CHG, and CHH contexts) based on USCS browser GCRm38/mm10 assembly annotations.
Perform gene ontology analysis with DAVID v6.7, reporting GO terms for CpG sites with a count of at least 9 genes and an enrichment score > 5.
